name: Media & Capture Suite (Media & Capture)
description: Industrial cross-platform desktop media suite covering screenshot, scroll capture, USB/RTSP camera, GIF/MP4 recording, dual-channel audio mixing, Candle Candle offline Whisper ASR, TTS, and mosaic masking.

CaptureImage.description: Universal screenshot action supporting full screen, active/specified window, and ROI crop with OCR white-flattening

CaptureScroll.description: Simulates smooth scrolling and stitches long webpage/chat screenshots seamlessly

CameraCapture.description: USB camera & RTSP stream capture with auto-single frame, persistent continuous mode, and close release

ScreenRecord.description: Records desktop or window activity and exports lightweight animated GIF

VideoRecord.description: Hardware-accelerated MP4 video recorder supporting dual-channel audio mixing and 30s crash/exception rolling buffer dump

AudioPlayer.description: Plays local audio files with volume/loop control, stops channels, and triggers system alert beeps

AudioRecord.description: Captures microphone input and saves as high-quality WAV audio file

AudioCaptureSystem.description: Captures all computer playback sounds (player, online meetings, calls) as lossless WAV

TextToSpeech.description: Uses offline system TTS voice to read input text aloud

SpeechToText.description: Hugging Face Candle Pure Rust offline ASR engine leveraging active settings panel Whisper model to transcribe audio

AudioExtract.description: Cross-platform passthrough audio track extraction from video (MP4 -> MP3/WAV/M4A) in milliseconds

MediaWatermark.description: Overlays dynamic text watermarks or applies pixelated mosaic/blur masking over sensitive areas

MediaInfo.description: Probes resolution, duration, channels, and format metadata of media files
